mcq.question: How is the field `Dwayne "The Rock" J` written in a CSV file?
mcq.explanation: RFC 4180 encloses the field in double quotes and represents each literal quote inside it as two quotes. Backslash escapes are not part of the CSV standard.

mcq.question: Why can't a CSV reader simply call `std::getline` once per record?

options.B: CSV files never use newline characters
options.C: Each field must be read with a separate `>>`
options.D: A quoted field may contain a line break, so one record can span several lines

mcq.explanation: Inside quotes, line breaks are part of the data. The reader must keep reading lines until the quote is closed before the record is complete.
